name: Calculadora Java

jobs:
  test-calculadora:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
	steps:
	
	  - name: subir datos
	    uses: actions/artifact@v5
	
	  - name: configurar java
	    uses: actions/setup-java@v5
	    with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'

      - name: Compilar y guardar en Out
        runs: |
          mkdir -p out
          javac -d out src/*.java

      - name: Ejecutar tests y subirlos
        runs: java -ae -cp out CalculadoraTest
